identify.description: Segment identify call mapped to Zendesk Users API — creates or updates a user via POST /api/v2/users/create_or_update

group.description: Segment group call mapped to Zendesk Organizations API — creates or updates an organization via POST /api/v2/organizations/create_or_update, then associates user via Organization Memberships API

identify.description: RudderStack identify call mapped to Zendesk Users API — creates or updates a user via POST /api/v2/users/create_or_update

group.description: RudderStack group call mapped to Zendesk Organizations API — creates or updates an organization via POST /api/v2/organizations/create_or_update, optionally associates user to organization. Behavior controlled by 'Send Group Calls without User ID' setting.

identify_to_user.description: Maps Segment/RudderStack identify call traits to Zendesk User API fields

standard_fields.traits.name: user.name — Full name; Segment parses firstName/lastName from name; RudderStack concatenates firstName+lastName if name not provided
standard_fields.traits.firstName: user.name — Combined with lastName to form full name if name trait not provided
standard_fields.traits.lastName: user.name — Combined with firstName to form full name if name trait not provided
standard_fields.traits.email: user.email — Primary email address; used as lookup key for user matching
standard_fields.userId: user.external_id — Segment/RudderStack userId maps to Zendesk external_id for user matching

custom_fields.description: Unmapped traits are sent as custom user_fields in Zendesk. Both Segment and RudderStack attempt to match traits to standard fields first, then fall back to user_fields.
custom_fields.format_conversion: Segment converts camelCase and snake_case trait names to snake_case for Zendesk user_fields. RudderStack follows the same convention.

verified_setting.description: Both Segment and RudderStack support a 'Create Users as Verified' destination setting. When enabled, user.verified is set to true, skipping Zendesk email verification.
verified_setting.segment_behavior: Controlled via 'Create Users as Verified' toggle in Segment destination settings
verified_setting.rudderstack_behavior: Controlled via 'Create users as verified' toggle in RudderStack dashboard settings

remove_from_organization.description: Both platforms support removing a user from an organization via identify call
remove_from_organization.segment_behavior: Enable 'Enable Removing Users from Organizations' setting; pass company.id and company.remove=true in traits
remove_from_organization.rudderstack_behavior: Enable 'Enable Removing Users from Organizations' setting; pass company.id and company.remove=true in traits

group_to_organization.description: Maps Segment/RudderStack group call traits to Zendesk Organization API fields, with optional user-to-organization membership association

standard_fields.traits.name: organization.name — Organization name (required)
standard_fields.traits.domain_names: organization.domain_names — Array of domain name strings
standard_fields.traits.shared_tickets: organization.shared_tickets — Boolean for shared ticket access
standard_fields.groupId: organization.external_id — Segment/RudderStack groupId maps to Zendesk external_id for organization matching

custom_fields.description: Unmapped group traits are sent as custom organization_fields in Zendesk

user_association.description: When both userId and groupId are present, the user is associated with the organization after org create/update
user_association.segment_behavior: Segment looks up the user and creates an organization_membership linking user to organization
user_association.rudderstack_behavior: RudderStack finds the user by email from context.traits.email, then creates organization_membership. Controlled by 'Send Group Calls without User ID' dashboard setting.
user_association.lookup_strategy: RudderStack: user found by email in context.traits; Segment: user found by userId/external_id

known_parity_gaps.user_association_lookup: RudderStack looks up user by email in context.traits for group-to-user association; Segment uses userId mapped to external_id — different lookup strategies may cause association mismatches if email is missing from context
known_parity_gaps.group_without_userid: RudderStack has 'Send Group Calls without User ID' setting to create/update org without user association; Segment does not have an equivalent toggle — group always attempts user association
known_parity_gaps.custom_field_format: Both convert trait names to snake_case for custom fields, but edge cases in camelCase-to-snake_case conversion may differ between platforms
known_parity_gaps.envelope_fields: RudderStack source events include additional fields: rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt — these are not sent to Zendesk but differ in the source event shape
known_parity_gaps.context_library: Different SDK library identifiers: Segment uses analytics.js; RudderStack uses rudder-sdk-js
known_parity_gaps.sunshine_events: Segment supports track calls via Zendesk Sunshine Events API for custom event tracking; RudderStack does not document Sunshine event support — track-to-Sunshine parity gap
known_parity_gaps.track_user_lookup: Segment maps track calls to Sunshine events using properties.email or userId as external_id with max 60 character limit; RudderStack Zendesk destination does not explicitly support track calls

required_settings.email: Email address used to log in to Zendesk account

optional_settings.create_users_as_verified: Boolean — when true, creates users with verified=true to skip email verification
optional_settings.send_group_calls_without_userid: Boolean (RudderStack-specific) — when true, creates/updates org without associating a user
optional_settings.enable_removing_users_from_organizations: Boolean — when true, allows removing users from organizations via identify call with company.remove=true
optional_settings.source_name: RudderStack-specific — events source name sent to Zendesk; defaults to 'Rudder'

destination_config.auth_method: HTTP Basic Auth with email/token:{api_token} format

notes: Zendesk shared cloud destination. Category: CRM. Both Segment and RudderStack support identify (user create/update) and group (organization create/update with optional user association) calls to Zendesk. Segment additionally supports track calls via Zendesk Sunshine Events API for custom event tracking — this is a parity gap for RudderStack. Authentication uses HTTP Basic with email/token:{api_token}. Key differences: user lookup strategy for group-to-user association (email vs external_id), RudderStack-specific 'Send Group Calls without User ID' toggle, and RudderStack envelope fields (rudderId, originalTimestamp, sentAt, receivedAt) in source events. Segment slug: zendesk. Segment also accepts track calls mapped to Sunshine custom events.
